alex-cust: Quick presales ask — we have ~10k ephemeral principals for matchmaking. We need BYOK (customer CloudHSM), KEK rotation every 4h, immutable per-key audit lines, and a cost/latency projection before legal signs SOW. Target p50 token latency is ~15ms.
zara-sales: we can run a focused POC. key assumptions to validate: principal cardinality, cache TTL, and rotation cadence. Will produce cost model mapping unwraps/sec -> monthly TCO.
lee-se: two architectures we'll validate in POC: (1) sidecar key-proxy with short in-memory cache of unwrapped KEKs (best latency), (2) strict KMS unwrap on each session (highest assurance, worse latency). For high cardinality, sidecar cache hit-rate drives unwrap/sec.
lee-se: minimal sidecar config we'll sweep in perf runs:
```yaml
sidecar:
  cache_ttl: 60s  # vary 15s/60s/300s
  max_unwrapped_keys: 32
  mem_lock: true
rotation:
  cron: "0 */4 * * *"
  jitter_pct: 5
```
sophia-security: auditors want HSM attestation PDF (vendor cert chain + firmware), signed proof-of-possession for CMEK, and per-op audit logs (event, key_id, principal, ts, request_id, actor). We'll provide canonical schema and sample files. For high-volume, we'll batch-compress logs before delivery.
alex-cust: can you paste one sample single-line audit event we can ingest into our SIEM?
lee-se: sample single-line JSON for SIEM ingestion: {"ts":"2026-05-12T21:05:11Z","event":"unwrap","key_id":"acme/prod/kek-202605","principal":"ephemeral/pu-7123","request_id":"r_x7f9","svc":"matchmaking"}
zara-sales: proposed POC plan (2.5 weeks):
- Day 0: kickoff, exchange firewall rules & attestation requirements
- Day 2: deploy sidecar matrix (cache_ttl variants) to staging, baseline perf (p50/p95)
- Day 5: cardinality sweep (100/1k/10k principals) to capture unwraps/sec vs p50
- Day 8: rotation stress (4h cadence x72h) with jitter, measure unwrap ops, error modes, and cost delta
- Day 12: deliver heatmaps (p50 vs unwraps/sec), attestation artifacts, and recommended config + SOW addendum
zara-sales: pricing note — HSM unwraps and egress are itemized. If unwrap/sec is large, Dedicated capacity or an unwrap-cap add-on can cap variable costs. We'll include a sensitivity table in the deliverable.
lee-se: perf harness will sweep three axes: cache_ttl (15/60/300s), principal_cardinality (100/1k/10k), and reuse_rate (0.0190.9). We'll output a heatmap and CSV of metrics. Example perf command: `./poc-run --qps 200 --cache-ttl 60 --principals 10000 --reuse 0.2 --rotate-cron "0 */4 * * *"`.
sophia-security: action items for attestation/audit: I'll attach a sample attestation filename (cloudhsm_attest_acme_20260512.pdf) and the canonical log schema. Also will validate FIPS-mode option if required.
alex-cust: please include a cost table mapping unwraps/sec -> monthly unwrap charges + expected p50 delta. If POC shows sidecar with cache_ttl=60s and reuse_rate>=0.5 meets ~15ms p50 and audit outputs are OK, we'll greenlight SOW.
gameops-bot: deploy-status: key-proxy v1.4 staged to stg-ephemeral at 2026-05-12T21:12:00Z :white_check_mark:
lee-se: I'll push the perf matrix tomorrow and a draft cost sensitivity table. Will also add a small regression test that forces rotations every 15 minutes to surface edge-case failures.
zara-sales: action items: @lee-se perf matrix + cost sensitivity, @sophia-security attach attestation + log schema, @alex-cust confirm peak QPS and whether FIPS is required.
alex-cust: thanks team — appreciate the clear plan. We'll confirm QPS and FIPS by EOD. :thumbsup:
